title: Earth & Spaceflight
description: Our planet and the missions that let us see it — from Apollo to deep space.

items.title: The Blue Marble
items.description_narrative: The Blue Marble is a celebrated photograph of Earth, captured from space during the Apollo 17 mission. This iconic image vividly showcases the full illuminated disk of our planet, displaying its oceans, landmasses, and cloud patterns.
items.tags: earth, space, photography, iconic, apollo, planet, global, view

items.title: Earthrise
items.agent_name: NASA / Goddard Space Flight Center / Arizona State University
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph, captured during the Apollo 8 mission, depicts Earth rising dramatically above the lunar horizon. It offers a profound view of our planet as a fragile, vibrant sphere in the vastness of space, shifting human perspective on our home.
items.tags: space, earth, moon, iconic, photography, apollo 8, scientific, 1960s

items.title: Pale Blue Dot
items.description_narrative: The 'Pale Blue Dot' captures Earth as a tiny, distant speck, suspended within a vast ray of sunlight. This iconic image was taken by the Voyager 1 space probe from a record-setting distance, emphasizing humanity's place in the cosmos.
items.tags: earth, space, cosmos, astronomy, photograph, scientific, vastness, exploration

items.title: Buzz Aldrin on the Moon Apollo 11
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures astronaut Buzz Aldrin on the lunar surface during the historic Apollo 11 mission. It vividly portrays a human presence on the Moon, reflecting the immense achievement of space exploration.
items.tags: space exploration, moon landing, apollo 11, buzz aldrin, astronaut, historic, photography

items.title: Bruce McCandless spacewalk
items.agent_name: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, NASA Johnson Space Center/Robert L. Gibson
items.description_narrative: This image captures astronaut Bruce McCandless during a spacewalk, a significant event in human space exploration. It documents a moment of daring and advancement beyond Earth's confines.
items.tags: spacewalk, astronaut, space, NASA, exploration, outer space, technology, human achievement

items.title: Saturn from Cassini
items.description_narrative: This striking view captures the gas giant Saturn and its intricate ring system, showcasing the planet's majestic scale and atmospheric details. Captured by the Cassini spacecraft, this image provides a detailed perspective of one of our solar system's most recognizable features.
items.tags: saturn, planet, rings, space, astronomy, scientific, solar system, cosmic

items.title: The Earth seen from Apollo 17
items.agent_name:
NASA. Photo taken by either Harrison Schmitt or Ron Evans (of the Apollo 17 crew).
Ævar Arnfjörð Bjarmason
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures a full view of Earth, showcasing its vibrant blue oceans and swirling white clouds against the black expanse of space. Known as 'The Blue Marble,' it was taken by an Apollo 17 crew member during humanity's last lunar mission.
items.tags: earth, planet, space, photography, astronaut, blue marble, global, nasa

items.title: Apollo 11 bootprint on the Moon
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures Buzz Aldrin's bootprint on the lunar surface during the Apollo 11 mission. It stands as a powerful symbol of humanity's first steps on another celestial body and the achievement of space exploration.
items.tags: space, moon, bootprint, astronaut, apollo 11, lunar, historic, exploration

items.title: The Day the Earth Smiled
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures Earth as a distant, pale blue dot from the vantage point of Saturn, inviting contemplation of humanity's place in the cosmos. It commemorates a unique moment in 2013 when people across Earth were encouraged to wave simultaneously as the Cassini spacecraft captured this image.
items.tags: earth, space, planetary photography, scientific imaging, cosmic perspective, distant view, human connection

items.title: Apollo 8 Crew Portrait
items.description_narrative: This photograph captures the three-person crew of Apollo 8, the first human spaceflight mission to orbit the Moon. Astronauts Frank Borman, James Lovell, and William Anders are depicted in their flight suits, representing a pivotal moment in space exploration.
items.tags: space, astronauts, portrait, Apollo program, NASA, space exploration, historic, photography

items.title: Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle
items.description_narrative: This image captures the Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle, as seen by astronaut Michael Collins. Collins, the Command Module pilot, orbited the Moon while his crewmates descended to its surface in this vehicle.
items.tags: space, moon, lunar module, Apollo 11, exploration, astronaut, historical, spacecraft

items.title: Curiosity Self-Portrait at Mars
items.description_narrative: The Curiosity rover, a robotic explorer, captured this intricate self-portrait on Mars using its Mars Hand Lens Imager (MAHLI). This mosaic image showcases the rover's design and its presence against the expansive, desolate Martian landscape.
items.tags: mars, rover, self-portrait, space exploration, scientific imaging, extraterrestrial, robotic art

items.title: Perseverance Selfie with Ingenuity
items.description_narrative: This image captures the Perseverance rover on the surface of Mars, presenting a self-portrait that includes the Ingenuity helicopter nearby. It serves as a remarkable record of robotic exploration and humanity's venture into understanding the Red Planet.
items.tags: mars, rover, ingenuity, perseverance, space exploration, robotics, scientific photography, self-portrait

items.title: Pluto New Horizons
items.agent_name: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Southwest Research Institute/Alex Parker
items.description_narrative: This striking image presents Pluto's varied surface, captured during the New Horizons mission's historic flyby. It reveals diverse geological features across the dwarf planet, offering unprecedented detail.
items.tags: space, dwarf planet, pluto, new horizons, planetary science, astronomical image, celestial body

items.title: Jupiter's Great Red Spot Juno
items.description_narrative: This image captures the colossal vortex of Jupiter's Great Red Spot, a persistent storm larger than Earth. It was captured by the Juno spacecraft during its close flyby and further processed to enhance its vibrant details.
items.tags: jupiter, great red spot, astronomy, space exploration, planetary science, nasa, scientific visualization, cosmic

items.title: Hubble Space Telescope in Orbit
items.description_narrative: This image captures the iconic Hubble Space Telescope as it orbits Earth, a pivotal instrument in astronomical discovery. Launched in 1990, Hubble has provided breathtaking views of the universe and critical data for scientific research.
items.tags: space, astronomy, hubble telescope, earth orbit, scientific research, technology, documentary
